'''Saren Valek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Near-Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the decades leading up to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Near-Human]], Saren Valek was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], studying at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] until he was selected as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to the respected [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec]]. During Valek's apprenticeship, the boy was seduced to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]] in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]].<ref name="CP">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref> Valek stole Alec's blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]<ref name="ISC" /> and abandoned his former master to train with Nalvas.<ref name="CP" /><ref name="ISC" /> For three years, Alec tracked the dark pair unsuccessfully.<ref name="CP" />

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Nalvas went to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] with Valek where he intended to build a giant, armored flying city with enough firepower to destroy any of the other flying cities above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. When the fortress, ''[[Conkesta]]'', was almost operative, Valek remained on board of her as it was maneuvered into position. As the warship became active, Alec sent a team of independent adventurers to infiltrate the ''Conkesta'' and upload a virus in her computer, hurtling her to her destruction in the planet's core and activating alarms during the process. Valek and eighteen guards went to the hangar, where they met the raiders. Valek contacted Nalvas using a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], and Nalvas ordered them to kill the intruders. Twelve of the guards chose not to obey, trying instead to abandon the doomed ship; Valek and the other guards did their best to stop the trespassers from leaving the ''Conkesta'' before it was obliterated.<ref name="ISC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The plot of ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds|Into the Storm Clouds]]'' suggests that the player characters either kill Valek or escape from him, leaving him to die in the condemned ''Conkesta''. Although canon specifies that the ''Conkesta'' is destroyed,<ref name="Tales of Nub Saar">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040408|text=Tales of Nub Saar}}</ref> it does not specify Valek's fate. Further sources featuring Nalvas (eg. ''[[A Mon Alone]]'') also fail to mention Valek or his death. Valek has two different sets of RPG statistics for the gamemaster to choose depending on the skill of the player characters.
